subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘DANCE’ is written as ‘AECDN’, ‘MUSIC’ is written as ‘IUCMS’, how will ‘SONG’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• Vowels → Rearranged first according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Consonants → Rearranged after vowels according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• ‘DANCE’ is written as ‘AECDN’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e301c301090456bdafb1f3d0676e8c11efc3ee25a89657ac6248a5a2fbbda1a.png] 

And,

 
• ‘MUSIC’ is written as ‘IUCMS’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f499d488f04a6ef449dee0adfca72923420db1254718949b891ea608bf8ad0e5.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘SONG’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcbf3ed22fc3b70c793d760814c0387a0ffda33da20a9476bd1d9b4558cd64b4.png] 

​Hence, "**OGNS**" is the correct answer.

3a
